description:

You see a closed fridge. Look over there! an oven. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a table. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. Hopefully, this discovery doesn't ruin your TextWorld experience! You can make out a counter. Wow, isn't TextWorld just the best? The counter is vast.
